persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a product photo of an amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label. The brand on the label must read VELORA, spelled exactly like that.
bank.Product and materials: An amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label.

messages.text: Could you make a product photo for me? I've had this idea in my head for a while and wanted to see it brought to life. The product is a hand soap bottle, and the details I mean are amber glass for the bottle and a cream label. On that label, the brand must read VELORA, all uppercase and spelled exactly like that. I'm probably over-explaining because I worry I'll forget to mention something important.
